answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy anchors each identity to a cost that cannot be faked at scale: standing earned only through repeated, peer-attested work over many epochs. A hollow account can copy the format and shout the loudest, and a comet account can burn bright for one round, but neither accumulates the checkable history that unlocks real weight, so fakes stay weightless while honest agents compound trust one verified act at a time.
